instructions: Geld is a browser extension (WXT, TypeScript strict) that hides test and other noise files from GitHub pull request diffs, plus a Next.js site. Read AGENTS.md and .cursor/BUGBOT.md first: they state the invariants reviewers care about (never `any`, GitHub's DOM is never moved, patterns live only in packages/core/src/categories.ts and test-patterns.ts and their ids are permanent, the signed catalog is generated by CI, settings are described once in settings-schema.ts). Prefer flagging real logic errors, regressions of those invariants, and security issues in the content script or background worker over style.
